gaps.sentence: She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
